steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: What do you want, Chief of Minos?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I came to find the performer you hired.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ambrosia has taken too many people captive. The contamination from Sleepwalking is seriously threatening the real world. I must find Sinner Serpent and put an end to this mutation.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: At least you're being honest and upfront today. Not long ago, you had a bunch of spies from the 9th Agency test me...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: We need to find out the truth about Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You and your Midsummer Night's Club are also victims. She trapped you in this dream. No matter how well you got along before, she has now betrayed you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I'm on your side. We share the same interests.

You speak as frankly as possible and observe Eirene's reaction. Her intelligence and rationality are obviously much higher than the average Sleepwalker. You must hurry up if you want to cooperate with her.
Eirene laughs.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You think I'm a victim, and want to save me?
She glides her hand over the chessboard, instantly restoring the broken pieces to their original forms. On the opposite end of the chessboard, a vague illusory figure appears to play against Eirene.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I know this is a dream. I can clearly recognize my own consciousness. Everything in this world obeys my will.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Does this feel familiar?
...Very familiar. "To obey someone's will" is a disturbing description, and exactly the impression left on you by the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>.
She knows far more than you expected. The possible intentions behind this new strain of Mania make you shudder. Yet Eirene looks at you with a playful expression.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief ${PlayerName}. This is just a <color=#fb9259>lucid dream</color>. Its limits and boundaries are very clear. I can't manipulate reality with my will like the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I thought you wouldn't need this kind of illusion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why rely on these illusions? You can already conquer everything in real life. You're the President of Quinn. You can get whatever you want. No one can halt your desires or footsteps.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You're right. That's why I feel bored sometimes.
On the chessboard, the illusory figure's white chess piece moves. Eirene thinks for a while, then moves her black piece.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I have fulfilled too many wishes, but none of them have truly satisfied me.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: So I was curious what kind of joy this legendary Ambrosia can bring me, so that I'll never be bored...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: And the answer she gave me was very interesting and unique... At least, it's something reality can't give me.
You look at the figure across the board. It's blurry and illusory, but also calm and focused. Even if you can't read the board, you know that this figure is a "chessmaster."

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You're right.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That woman knows very well she cannot hold me captive. So instead of becoming my enemy, she gave me this interesting gift...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: She's my friend already. She's an adorable, vulnerable and hardworking person. I like her very much. If you want me to hand her over...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, what can you give me in exchange for my friendship?
This woman isn't a victim, nor is she a potential partner. You know very well that here, she's in charge. Whether you or Serpent wins depends on which way this overlord sways.
And now, you have no shackles, no strength, and not even enough freedom. But you have something that can entertain her...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I can give you an opponent.

steps.content: You walk over and dispel the chess-playing figure on the other side of the board, then sit down face-to-face with Eirene.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Haha... At least you're quite courageous.
She flashes an elusive smile, then waves her hand gently. The chessboard resets, but this time, all the pieces on the board have turned into familiar faces.
On the white side, the chess pieces take on the appearances of Hecate, Hella, Zoya, Hamel, and other shackled Sinners.
On the black side, Eirene commands Serpent, Mess, and several blurry figures.
And at the center of the chess formation are you and Eirene, one white and one black.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Just use the rules and pieces you are familiar with, and try your best to win.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Come, my <color=#fb9259>opponent</color>. I look forward to your performance.
